title: Amazing Harmony House with RoofTop View
description:
Experience Nashville this autumn from your own private rooftop deck! This professionally designed 4-story luxury home features a spacious open-concept kitchen & living area, 4 large bedrooms, and plenty of room to entertain or unwind. Enjoy a roomy 2-car garage with direct home access + Tesla charger. Your perfect Music City stay awaits! Mid-term, insurance & temporary housing stays welcome.

The space
A high rise home with lots of space and private car entrance.

Guest access
Whole house is private for your use.

Other things to note
Stunning views of downtown from the rooftop private deck area!
